title: Birmingham City Council: the Foundry
summary: Birmingham reports that AI redacts documents in 90 seconds instead of 10 minutes and indexes 55% of emails, saving staff time and costs.
account: Birmingham reports that its Foundry tools automate redaction, mailbox indexing, administrative work, and simple translation. Redaction reportedly takes 90 seconds instead of 10 minutes with 95% success. Mail indexing reportedly handles 55% of emails, saving 5,500 staff hours and £100,000 annually. The former £350,000 translation budget is not a demonstrated saving. The source also reports translation limitations and guardrail difficulties.
purpose: Automate repetitive administration, document redaction, simple translation, and email routing.
system: Birmingham Foundry tools using Microsoft Copilot and UiPath Document Understanding and mailbox indexing
developer: Birmingham City Council, Microsoft, and UiPath

ratings.reason: Reported redaction and mailbox-indexing savings are time/cost gains. Prospective translation savings and avoided fines are not included in the depth.
The source reports reduced repetitive work, more time for meaningful duties, and improved job satisfaction. The modest grade does not assume a lasting wellbeing change.

ai_role.statement: AI performs specific document and email tasks in the reported deployments. The redaction and indexing figures are council claims. Translation savings remain partly prospective, and the broader culture changes also involve staff co-development.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Birmingham City Council: the Foundry

produced_by: Council officers and developers co-designed tools around four back-office functions in iterative development cycles.
The reported redaction tool covers three document types, and the mailbox tool handles a share of incoming emails.
must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported benefit.

headline: Birmingham reports faster redaction and automated email indexing

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The deployer's report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
